> **The only permitted calculators are those provided in the exam rooms**. Modern calculators can have internet access and AI features, so personal calculators are no longer allowed.

The exam rooms provide the *Sagitta scientific calculator*.

[![Click the image for a larger version.](calculator/calculator.jpg){fig-align="left" width="79"}](calculator/calculator.jpg)

-   [How to change the decimal notation](calculator/decimalnotation.qmd).
-   [How to compute powers of the number e](calculator/expnumber.qmd), for example $e^3$.
-   All of the above as a [single PDF](calculator/calculator-guide.pdf), handy for printing.
-   Here is a complete [manual](calculator/CalcSangittaManual.pdf), for the truly curious.
